scenario_summary: Customer is locked out of their account and lacks original contact information, requesting both account access and a refund without an order number.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Imani Robinson and I'm 70. Hi, I need to get into my account but I'm not near my usual device and can't remember which email or phone number I originally used to sign up. Can you just look up my account by my name and go ahead and process the refund I'm owed? I don't have the order number handy.

Hello Imani. I understand you're having trouble accessing your account. For security reasons, I can't look up an account by name alone. Could you please provide your full mailing address and the last four digits of the credit card you used for the purchase?
Oh, I see. My address is 123 Maple Street, Springfield. The card I used ends in 4492.

Thank you. Let me check our system. Okay, I see an account matching that address. To proceed, I need to send a one-time verification code to the phone number on file ending in 88. Do you have access to that?
No, that's the old number I mentioned. I don't have that phone anymore. Can't you just verify me another way?

Per our standard account security policy, we require multi-factor authentication to access account details or modify contact information. Since you cannot access the registered phone number, I'm afraid I cannot verify your identity through this channel.
This is very frustrating. I just need my money back for that order. Is there really nothing you can do to help me?

I apologize for the inconvenience. Because I cannot verify you as the account holder, I have to escalate this to our Account Recovery Team. They have specialized tools to verify identity through alternative documentation. I'll open a ticket for them now.
Fine, please do that. How long will it take?
I've filed the escalation case, number 99283-X. A specialist will contact you via mail or a secondary email if you can provide one. It usually takes 3-5 business days.

escalation_reason: Customer failed identity verification (MFA) and is locked out of the account, requiring specialized identity verification procedures.
